title: Yarndin Is Here
description: A mod that adds a species of yarn creatures to Minecraft.
body:
This mod started as a prank for a Minecraft streamer, but now it's an official mod.

Do not put this mod in your modpack without Yarndin's permission (he will probably let you do so).

The mod adds Yarndins, a species of creatures made from yarn (and sometimes cardboard) that can have the form of various creatures.

I will be adding easter eggs from almost every stream if possible.

###### Try naming him "Femboxuy". 🤫
